name: spring-pr-review
description: Review a Spring Boot pull request: what each commit does, impact, config keys and database migrations (Flyway, Liquibase YAML/XML/SQL, per database) compared with what each environment overrides, Kafka consumer and topic risks, code findings. Reads the PR, merge status and CI builds from Bitbucket Server/DC when configured (GET only), scans the git range locally, writes the report from a fixed Markdown template, optional Telegram summary when asked.
